Proficiency with the number concept in the 0-20 range substantively supports success in explaining additive relationships among those numbers, a pair-specific deepening from number concept to number relationships in operations rather than mere repetition; source row ordering (row 5 then row 6) is consistent but not relied upon as the basis.
